name: Turtle
trained: Taught itself by playing against a perfect opponent who could see its cards, overnight on mainstream hardware. Learned to give away as little as possible.
note: The default: a tight, patient player. It folds a lot before the flop and picks its spots.

name: Ox
trained: Taught itself by playing a billion hands against itself. Sorts hands ten times more finely than Turtle.
note: Plays a wider range than Turtle, and is the stronger of the two head to head. Which one is more fun to play is up to you -- try both.
